title: Matam Hai Dojahan May Mushkil Kusha Ali Ka_
body:
Matam Hai Dojahan May Mushkil Kusha Ali Ka.
Nouha Hai Har Zubaan Par Shere Quda Ali Ka.
1.Matam Hai Dojahan May Mushkil Kusha Ali Ka.
Nouha Hai Har Zubaan Par Shere Quda Ali Ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Mehrab Or Musalla Rangeen Hai Lahoo Se.
Qatil Ne Haaye Zaqmi Sar Kardiya Ali Ka.
3.Arshe Bareen Pe Nouha Jibreel Padhraha Hai.
Hoor O Malak May Matam Barpa Hai Wa Ali Ka.
4.Taari Hai Ghash Ka Aalam Har Ek Rooraha Hai.
Shiyon Ke Sar Se Utha Lo Aasra Ali Ka.
5.Laaya Tha Zeher May Wo Talwar Ko Bujhakar.
Zaalim Ne Yunn Utara Ehsaan Kya Ali Ka.
6.Zainab Ke Baein Sunkar Rooti Hain Bibiyaan Sab.
Baitul Sharaf Bana Hai Matam Kada Ali Ka.
7.Bewaa Yateem Rokar Koofe Ke Kehrahe Hain.
Dukh Dard May Tha Humko Ek Aasra Ali Ka.
8.Ashke Azaye Sarwar Aankhon May Aagaye Hain.
Tune Layeeq Jisdam Nouha Likha Ali Ka.
<<MINI>>
Matam Hai Dojahan May Mushkil Kusha Ali Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
AZZ:- LAYEEQ ALI LAYEEQ
